shortDescription: According to ChainCatcher citing Lookonchain, a whale bought 9,677 ETH two weeks ago and sold 3,700 ETH five hours ago to reduce losses. The address is currently down $5.36 million.

title: Whale Sells 3,700 ETH Two Weeks After Buying 9,677, Facing a $5.36 Million Loss
